tldr: For the binary Figure 7 graph with its independent latent roots, \(p\in M\) is equivalent on every support stratum to \(J(p)\) and a one-parameter response system. It has 36 raw coordinates and, after simplex elimination and one response-equation redundancy per supported cell, 35 free coordinates and at most 116 inequality rows. Rational laws have an exact quartic root-partition compatibility certificate and attained sharp \(D\)-to-\(Y\) effect endpoints of algebraic degree at most four. On strictly positive laws, the nested Markov model is exactly the stated observable equality model, verified by all 22 reachable fixing kernels. Positive rational witnesses give \(M^+\subsetneq Mm^+\subsetneq N^+\); at a further positive law, the true-model ACE interval is \([17/32,25/32]\), while the merged-root interval is \([-1/8,7/8]\).
gap: The published Figure 7 analysis merges the two roots and gives necessary constraints; a graph-specific exact compatibility test retaining their independence is not supplied.
